objective: Build a delightful useful post office where a lost minute of scrolling is returned as a small act of care for a neighbor. Give people something they can do without watching the screen, and never track their kindness.
creativeSeed: A bureaucratic time-travel post office mails people back their missing minutes. Returned minutes become imaginary stamps marked LISTEN, HELP, NOTICE.
challenge: Deliver a wholly new finished original film plus printable interactive local action kit, test native source-bound revision and two feedback loops.
